key.name: enabled-layouts
key.description: List of enabled keyboard layouts.

key.name: current-layout
key.description: The ID of the currently active keyboard layout.

key.name: show-prediction-bar
key.description: Whether to show the predictive text suggestion bar.

key.name: auto-correction-enabled
key.description: Whether to automatically correct misspelled words.

key.name: haptic-feedback-enabled
key.description: Whether to provide haptic feedback on key press.

key.name: key-press-sound-enabled
key.description: Whether to play a sound on key press.

key.name: theme-name
key.description: The name of the currently active visual theme.

key.name: application-layouts
key.description: Mapping of application IDs to preferred keyboard layout IDs. Example: {'org.gnome.Terminal': 'terminal_layout'}

key.name: keyboard-height
key.description: Height of the virtual keyboard in pixels.

key.name: keyboard-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the virtual keyboard (0.0 to 1.0).

key.name: auto-show-enabled
key.description: Whether to automatically show the keyboard when a text field is focused.

key.name: gesture-swipe-enabled
key.description: Whether to enable swipe gestures for navigation and editing.

key.name: glide-typing-enabled
key.description: Whether to enable glide (swipe) typing for faster input.

key.name: suggestion-count
key.description: Number of word suggestions to display (1-5).

key.name: ml-learning-enabled
key.description: Whether to enable machine learning for personalized predictions.

key.name: gesture-sensitivity
key.description: Sensitivity of gesture recognition (0-100).

key.name: gesture-visualization
key.description: Whether to show visual feedback for gestures.

key.name: layout-auto-switch
key.description: Whether to automatically switch layouts based on application.

key.name: show-layout-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the current layout indicator on the keyboard.

key.name: layout-preview-on-hover
key.description: Whether to show layout preview when hovering over the layout indicator.

key.name: prediction-cache-size
key.description: Maximum number of predictions to cache for performance.

key.name: vocabulary-learning
key.description: Whether to learn new words from user input.

key.name: keyboard-size
key.description: Size of the keyboard: compact, normal, or large.

key.name: docking-position
key.description: Position where the keyboard docks: top, bottom, left, right, or floating.

key.name: high-contrast-enabled
key.description: Increase color contrast for better visibility.

key.name: large-keys-enabled
key.description: Increase key size for easier targeting.

key.name: slow-motion-enabled
key.description: Slow down animations for better visibility.

key.name: auto-hide-enabled
key.description: Whether to automatically hide the keyboard when text field loses focus.

key.name: clipboard-history-enabled
key.description: Track clipboard history for quick access to recently copied items.

key.name: clipboard-history-max-items
key.description: Maximum number of clipboard items to store (1-100).

key.name: clipboard-history-privacy-mode
key.description: Do not track sensitive data (passwords, etc.) in clipboard history.

key.name: clipboard-history-ttl
key.description: Time-to-live in seconds for clipboard items (0 = never expire).

key.name: clipboard-history-search-enabled
key.description: Allow searching within clipboard history.

key.name: emoji-recently-used-enabled
key.description: Keep track of recently used emojis for quick access.

key.name: emoji-skin-tone
key.description: Default skin tone for emojis that support skin tone variants.

key.name: emoji-recent-limit
key.description: Maximum number of recently used emojis to store (1-100).

key.name: emoji-search-enabled
key.description: Allow searching for emojis by name or keywords.

key.name: special-chars-custom-sets
key.description: List of custom character set IDs to display in the special characters panel.

key.name: special-chars-show-unicode
key.description: Display Unicode code points alongside special characters.

key.name: theme-auto-dark-light
key.description: Automatically switch between light and dark themes based on system preference.

key.name: theme-accent-color
key.description: Custom accent color in hex format (e.g., #007bff). Empty uses theme default.

key.name: theme-font-size-scale
key.description: Scale factor for font sizes (0.5 to 2.0).

key.name: theme-custom-css
key.description: Additional custom CSS to apply to the keyboard.

key.name: accessibility-sticky-keys
key.description: Allow modifier keys (Shift, Ctrl, Alt) to stay active after release.

key.name: accessibility-key-repeat-delay
key.description: Delay in milliseconds before key repeat starts (100-2000).

key.name: accessibility-key-repeat-rate
key.description: Rate in milliseconds between repeated key events (20-200).

key.name: accessibility-color-blind-mode
key.description: Color adjustment for color blindness: none, protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia.

key.name: accessibility-dyslexia-font
key.description: Use a font designed for better readability with dyslexia.

key.name: accessibility-screen-reader
key.description: Provide accessibility information to screen readers (ATK/ATSPI).

key.name: accessibility-focus-indicator
key.description: Display a visual indicator for focused keyboard elements.

key.name: accessibility-tooltips
key.description: Display tooltips for keyboard buttons and controls.

key.name: voice-input-enabled
key.description: Enable voice input via microphone (requires permissions).

key.name: voice-input-language
key.description: Language code for voice recognition (e.g., en-US, fr-FR).

key.name: voice-input-sensitivity
key.description: Sensitivity of voice recognition (0-100).

key.name: ibus-integration-enabled
key.description: Integrate with IBus input method framework for better compatibility.

key.name: ibus-language
key.description: Default language for IBus input method.

key.name: ibus-input-mode
key.description: Input mode for IBus: direct or preedit.
